name: SGLang end-to-end request latency histogram
notes: SGLang main, python/sglang/srt/observability/metrics_collector.py, read 2026-10-04. NOT ON BY DEFAULT: nothing is exported unless --enable-metrics (ServerArgs default False), which is also the only thing that mounts /metrics on the server port. Label keys are model_name, engine_type, tp_rank, pp_rank, moe_ep_rank (plus dp_rank under data parallelism, priority under priority scheduling, and anything in extra_metric_labels). Bucket ladders are overridable per histogram via get_histogram_conf_from_env. Unlike the queue-time ladder this one starts at 0.1 s and steps coarsely (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8) before widening, so it resolves sub-second e2e latency but not a 50 ms SLO.
